description: Construction inspection schedule emitted by the gov-municipality inspection_scheduling Pregel cell. Lists the per-phase inspection slots booked with the jurisdiction's inspection department, one row per construction phase (foundation / structural / MEP / finishing / commissioning). Each slot is anchored to the parent permitApplicationId and carries the jurisdiction-issued slot reference. Per ADR-2605250800 + gate G1 (open-source RPC) and the tatekata phase-gate cross-actor contract (each phase's `*_complete` gate cites the corresponding slot's `slotReference`).

permitApplicationId.description: Parent application identifier (links back to permitApplication.applicationId).

jurisdictionCode.description: ISO-3166-2 + optional municipality suffix; MUST match the parent application's jurisdictionCode.

slots.description: Ordered inspection slots; one per construction phase. Order MUST match phase execution order.

scheduledAt.description: Timestamp the schedule was finalized with the jurisdiction. Re-scheduling emits a new record (immutable history).

jurisdictionRpcAttestationCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the RPC traces (one per slot booking) used to schedule.

phase.description: Construction phase this inspection covers. Matches the 5-phase tatekata R1 ladder.

slotReference.description: Jurisdiction-issued slot reference (booking number / appointment ID). Cited by the phase's `*_complete` gate record.

inspectorContactRef.description: Optional opaque reference to the assigned inspector (e.g. jurisdiction internal officer ID). PII filter applies — full name/contact details MUST NOT be persisted here.
